sources.title: Caching with rental cost and zapping
sources.snippet: The \emph{file caching} problem is defined as follows. Given a cache of size $k$ (a positive integer), the goal is to minimize the total retrieval cost for the given sequence of requests to files. A file $f$ has size $size(f)$ (a positive integer) and retrieval cost $cost(f)$ (a non-negative number) for bringing the file into the cache.
